title: Sega Screams Volume 2
overview:
Sega Screams Volume 2 is a Sega Saturn sampler disc mixing playable demos with video previews.

Playable demos:
- Die Hard Arcade
- Saturn Bomberman
- Amok
- Scorcher

Video previews:
- Shining the Holy Ark
- The Lost World: Jurassic Park
- Fighters Megamix
- Duke Nukem 3D
- Sky Target
- Manx TT SuperBike
